job.title: Associate Systems Administrator
job.description:
We’re currently recruiting on behalf of a fast-growing global technology business for an Associate Systems Administrator to join its Dublin-based IT Systems team.

This is a great opportunity for an IT professional looking to develop their career within a global environment, working across systems administration, endpoint management, IAM, networking and security.

As the Associate Systems Administrator you will be responsible for:

  • Administer identity platforms such as Okta / OneLogin Support Microsoft Intune / Jamf and endpoint management
  • Helpdesk support
  • Assist with software deployments, patching and OS updates
  • Troubleshoot Wi-Fi, VPN and firewall issues
  • Support Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and Slack
  • Manage user joiner/mover/leaver processes and access controls
  • Maintain technical documentation, runbooks and knowledge-base articles
  • Assist with office networking, AV and infrastructure
  • Participate in an on-call rotation when required

As the Associate Systems Administrator you will have the following experience:

✔️ Experience with IAM ( Okta or OneLogin)
✔️ Familiarity with Intune or Jamf
✔️ Experience using ServiceNow, Jira or similar ticketing platforms
✔️ Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and Slack
✔️ Basic enterprise networking and troubleshooting knowledge
✔️ Strong documentation and communication skills
✔️ Commerical experience in IT support / systems administration

We are offering a hybrid working model, competitive package+ more!

Please contact hello AT Freshtechit.com

job.title: Paid Social Specialist
job.description:
Paid Social & Performance Creative Growth Expert

We’re looking for a performance-minded growth expert to help scale Paid Social and performance creative for a growing international B2C business based in the heart of the City!

This is a role at the intersection of Paid Social, data, creative strategy and commercial growth.

You’ll own Paid Social performance while building a structured approach to understanding why creative works, turning those insights into meaningful tests, and scaling winning concepts across audiences and markets.

As the Paid Social & Creative Specialist, you will be responsible for:

  • Owning Paid Social strategy, performance and growth across Meta and TikTok
  • Analyse media, funnel and sales data to understand what drives customer quality, revenue and profitability
  • Connect platform data with GA4, funnel and CRM data to understand the full customer journey
  • Make commercially sound decisions when data is incomplete, volumes are low or the signal is ambiguous
  • Identify opportunities to improve acquisition performance and scale what works

Lead performance creative strategy

  • Build and own a creative testing roadmap across concepts, hooks, messaging, formats, audiences and creators
  • Deconstruct winning creatives into the elements that drive performance
  • Translate performance insights into creative concepts, briefs and scripts
  • Build a repeatable, modular creative testing framework
  • Determine creative volume and refresh cadence based on spend, performance and fatigue
  • Scale winning concepts across markets and platforms

Build our creator & influencer engine

  • Develop a network of creators and influencers as both a customer acquisition channel and source of high-performing paid-media creative
  • Work with creators, agencies, production partners and internal creative teams
  • Develop a measurable approach to creator marketing and continually test what works.

As the Paid Social and Creative Specialist you will have the following experience and attributes:

  • Strong hands-on experience managing and scaling Paid Social
  • Deep Meta experience.
  • B2C/DTC experience, particularly lead generation through to offline purchase
  • Experience with website lead generation and/or Instant Leads
  • A strong understanding of performance creative, direct-response advertising and experimentation
  • The ability to turn performance insights into clear creative ideas, briefs and scripts
  • Strong analytical skills across media platforms, GA4, funnel and CRM/sales data
  • A commercial mindset, with experience being accountable for revenue, acquisition performance and profitability
  • Experience working with creators, influencers, agencies and/or production partners
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to turn complex performance data into clear actions for creative teams and senior stakeholders
  • An entrepreneurial mindset and enthusiasm for experimenting with new platforms, tools and technologies

Any experience of the following is desirable:

A creative background in film, video, image production, visual arts, copywriting or editing

Experience with Smartly

Experience with ad tracking and event conversion imports

Experience with advanced ad or creative automation, particularly AI-powered tools

What success looks like

You’ll be successful if you can grow Paid Social revenue while maintaining or improving profitability, and build a repeatable creative testing system that consistently produces new opportunities for growth.

We are offering a great package+ benefits. Please contact for more details.

job.title: Senior VIP Executive Support
job.description:
Our client, a leading financial organisation are seeking a VIP Executive Support Specialist to provide support to their most senior leaders. This role is a unique hybrid of elite systems engineering and high-touch hospitality, requiring someone who can manage complex technical infrastructures while maintaining the polish and discretion necessary for C-Suite interaction.

You will be the primary technology partner for the Executive Office, ensuring that the firm’s leadership remains connected, secure, and productive, whether in the boardroom, at home, or traveling internationally.

Key Responsibilities

  • Executive Technology Concierge: Act as the dedicated point of contact for C-Suite executives and Board members, providing rapid-response support for hardware, software, and secure remote access.
  • High-Stakes Event Leadership: Own the technical success of Board meetings and high-profile hybrid events, managing enterprise A/V, Zoom/Teams Rooms, and real-time troubleshooting.
  • Infrastructure Engineering: Balance daily support with long-term engineering projects, including Intune deployments, PowerShell automation, and Windows-based VDI management.
  • Secure Global Mobility: Provision and secure executive "travel kits," validating international connectivity and VPN protocols to ensure seamless global operations.
  • Tailored Coaching: Provide 1-on-1 technology briefing and "concierge-style" onboarding for new executives, focusing on Microsoft 365 productivity and AI-enabled tools.

Required Qualifications

  • Industry Experience: Solid commercial experience in IT support, with experience of VIP or Executive support capacity (Financial Services or Legal experience is highly preferred).
  • Technical Mastery: Advanced expertise in the Microsoft 365 E5 suite, Entra ID (Azure AD), and Intune/Endpoint Manager.
  • Platform Breadth: Expert-level knowledge of Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android platforms.
  • Engineering Skills: Hands-on experience with scripting (PowerShell) and Group Policy (GPO) administration.
  • Communication: Ability to translate complex cybersecurity and technical concepts into concise, actionable advice for non-technical senior leaders.

Candidate Profile

  • Discretion: You have a proven track record of handling sensitive, confidential information with absolute integrity.
  • Poise: You remain calm and effective in high-pressure situations, such as technical failures during live executive presentations.
  • Proactivity: You don’t wait for tickets; you anticipate technical friction points and resolve them before they impact the leadership team.
  • Flexibility: Willingness to travel on short notice and provide after-hours support during critical executive movements.

We are offering a competitive package + benefits.

The role requires you to be onsite 5 days a week.

Please contact for more details.

job.title: Senior Data Scientist
job.description:
Senior Data Scientist (Machine Learning) – NYC

We’re currently working with a high-profile financial firm in New York that is looking to hire a Senior Data Scientist to join their growing team.

This is a hands-on role focused on building and deploying Machine Learning models across large-scale operational and investment datasets. The position will suit someone who enjoys solving complex problems and working closely with both technical and commercial teams.

The initial focus of the role will be around Bitcoin mining operations, using ML to improve performance, predict hardware failures, and optimize operational efficiency across a large fleet of devices.

Key experience required:

• Strong commercial experience within Data Science / Machine Learning

• Python and ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow

• Experience with Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, or SageMaker

• Knowledge of anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, and time-series modelling

• Comfortable working with large, noisy datasets

• Strong communication skills and ability to work with senior stakeholders

• Advanced degree (MSc/PhD) preferred

The role offers the opportunity to work on genuinely interesting ML problems within a collaborative and high-performing environment.
